title: TriageSuggestion
description: An issue-triage suggestion produced by the riptask AI helper. The output is a single JSON object that validates strictly against this schema. No additional properties are allowed.

status.description: Suggested issue status. One of the riptask states (todo, doing, blocked, done) or null if no suggestion is appropriate.

priority.description: Suggested priority. One of low, medium, high, critical or null if no suggestion is appropriate.

labels.description: Suggested labels. Each label is a non-empty string up to 64 characters. The array may be empty.
